title: Our Small Garden
introduction: در این داستان واژه‌های مربوط به طبیعت و کارهای روزمره را تمرین می‌کنی.
paragraphs: Mia and her brother have a small garden behind their house. Every Saturday, they work in the garden together.
Mia waters the flowers, and her brother cleans the garden. They plant tomatoes and carrots in the spring. The plants need sunlight and water.
One morning, Mia sees a small yellow flower. “Look! We have our first flower,” she says. Her brother takes a photo.
They feel proud because their garden is growing. They want to plant more flowers next month.
